Sko Compounds

US-based vendor (Beverly Hills, CA)· Scored August 2026· sko-compounds.com

Sko Compounds is a Beverly Hills, California-based research peptide vendor with an active TikTok presence and over 10,000 orders shipped. Third-party testing is claimed with a public COA page. Credit card processing is confirmed and Trustpilot shows 256 reviews at a 4-star aggregate with named staff responding publicly. The testing laboratory is not named in public materials, which is the single largest gap in the documentation architecture.

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
No community-commissioned independent test results (third-party purchase and lab submission) identified in public forums as of August 2026. This field will be updated as independent results are published.
Community Experience
256 Trustpilot reviews with a 4-star aggregate as of August 2026. Positive feedback cites fast shipping, responsive customer service, and product quality. Some negative reviews note resolution delays. Named staff (Operations Manager Patricia, TikTok presence Ethan) responding publicly to reviews is a positive operational signal.
Scoring Notes
Testing lab not named - the primary verifiability gap
No specific third-party laboratory name appears in publicly reviewed materials. Without a named lab, a buyer cannot cross-check a COA result against the lab's own public records. The claim of independent testing cannot be externally confirmed beyond Sko Compounds' own documents. Naming the testing lab publicly would be the single highest-impact change to the score.
Multiple domain variants complicate buyer navigation
Sko Compounds operates across sko-compounds.com, skocompounds.com, and skocompounds.store. Multiple domains for a single vendor can complicate COA verification and buyer navigation. Buyers should confirm which domain is primary before purchasing.
Trustpilot track record and named staff are positive signals
256 Trustpilot reviews with a 4-star aggregate and named staff responding publicly suggest a genuine operating business. The TikTok-native marketing model with a named community-facing employee is an unusual positive signal for a newer vendor. These signals are captured in Track Record and Community Experience, not in the testing-transparency dimensions.
